description: 34 decidable submission cases over the Meridian Review handling rules. Structurally identical to the withdrawn KESTREL-34 measure, rule for rule and key for key; only the semantics changed, after KESTREL-34 was found to trip a cyber-category safety classifier and make the sender unable to compose a brief.
